page.layout: One page of text, centred; no margin notes; a faint digitiser credit at the bottom right (ignored).

main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: flagrantissimo affectu Tiguri, Helvetiorum Metropoli, die xiii. Calendis Februariis. Anno Christiano MDCLXXXVII.
main_text.head: SERENISSIMÆ CELSITUDINIS TUÆ
main_text.p: JOH. HENRICUS HEIDEGGERUS; S. S. Theol. D. & in Academia Tigurina Professor.

page.notes: The page is largely faded, with show-through from the reverse side in the lower and middle areas; those mirrored fragments are not transcribed. The signature block is set in capitals and small capitals; "Tigu-rina" is hyphenated at the line end. Lines "Devotissimus Cultor" and "servusque humillimus" are set as a title block and are transcribed as printed.
